A declared-fictional near-future photographic crime reconstruction showing robbery as a forced property-transfer relation: one adult offender compels a distinct adult courier through a directed crowbar threat while taking the same case from the courier's control, with a reference-guided adult station investigator remaining a secondary supporting witness.

A declared-fictional near-future cinematic crime photograph inside a glass desert-observatory tram station during a violent sleet storm. A distinct adult offender faces an adult rare-map courier. The courier still grips the handle of a red leather case containing a brass astronomical chronometer, clearly holding it against her body; the offender clamps the other side of that same red case and pulls it toward his own body while raising a steel crowbar directly toward the courier in a credible coercive threat. The shared handle, opposing arm tension, and the case crossing the space between them make the forced transfer readable in one frame. Secondary at the edge, an adult station investigator with an oval face, dark eyes, softly arched brows, and long center-parted dark wavy hair presses an emergency alarm and watches the event. Stranded commuters shelter behind structural glass. Use a 28mm eye-level environmental frame, sodium-vapor pools, red signal beacons, sleet-streaked glass, crisp hands and case ownership cues, and realistic documentary texture.
